tolerance_cm.provenance: chosen by the owner's request of 2026-10-30 that the LaTeX rendering of the Mitacs v2 form be visually identical to Word: 0.02 cm (0.2 mm) is under one pixel at 120 dpi, the resolution word2latex renders pages at for visual checks

match_prefix_chars.provenance: chosen 2026-10-30 while comparing the Mitacs v2 form: long enough that two different lines of that form never share a prefix, short enough to survive a line whose end moved to the next line

ignored_glyphs.provenance: measured 2026-10-30: Word draws these symbols with a fallback font (Segoe UI Symbol, MS Gothic, Cambria Math) as separate spans, so they are dropped from the matching key; their position is still covered by the line's x0

list_label_regex.provenance: measured 2026-10-30: Word extracts a list label and its text as one line while LaTeX may emit the label as its own line; the label is stripped from the key only, never from the reported text

max_extra_reported.provenance: chosen 2026-10-30: candidate lines with no reference match are listed up to this count in the human report; the JSON report always carries all of them
